statement: Five main stats for catching sampling: catching efficiency (base stat and multi-bug multiplier) catching speed multi-bug chance printer sample rate and AFK gain rate.
Catching efficiency is the base stat needed for any catching and also raises the multiplier on multi-bug chance.
Catching speed is how fast you swing your net; more is better.
Catching speed has no cap so any source helps increase gains.
Multi-bug chance is capped at 300% and needed for high sampling rates; the bug squared bubble equipped raises the cap from 100% to 300%.
Printer sample rate is visible in the construction tab and is capped at 90%; easy way to increase printer gains.
All AFK gain rate or skill AFK gain rate is a basic multiplier that gives more resources across all other stats.
Gear for catching efficiency: sleek coif 10% feral leather 10% bandido pantalon 12% and spaghetti Westeros 35%.
Depending on your total efficiency magma gear or dreadlo gear may be best in slot.
Always use the spaghetti Westeros since its 35% catching efficiency blows the magma gear out of the water.
At higher agility and levels you may get more gains using the all-stat gear pieces instead.
Divine scarf is best in slot for the pendant.
If you can't make the divine scarf use the prances bouquet from the dungeon Furbo shop as second best but divine scarf is much better.
Use serrated Rex rings (8% skill efficiency to all skills) as best in slot rings.
Have at least three sets of the rings so agility-specific characters can use them.
First priority on the specials tab is the gem snoozy cap premium hat giving 10% all AFK gain.
Ideally you want a hat that increases agility rather than wisdom but he doesn't have an agility cap.
Idol skiller trophy is best in slot trophy giving 15% skill efficiency.
Without the idol skiller trophy use the blunder hills trophy for 3% AFK gain rate.
Use the giant starflower wings for 133% all AFK gain rate.
Fallbacks for wings: angel wings or other roses with lower AFK gain then gilded wings for skill efficiency.
Keychains should be all AFK gain rate; use the two best all AFK gain keychains you can find.
Most important tool is the dreadlo net for catching speed catching power and agility.
All other tool slots should be agility tools; make a dedicated agility tool set.
Agility on tools is multiplied roughly nine times; 30 agility gives roughly 300-400 extra agility.
Use the best tools in every slot and level them up so skill mastery is more effective later.
Use golden grilled cheese nuit for more percent to all stats giving more agility and thus efficiency.
Use two speed foods: buttered toast and the event item mistletoe berries for more catching speed.
Speed foods are consumed fast; unequip them after sampling because automation arm can use them up and they are hard to get back.
Few useful talents per tab so you have many spare points to spend as you wish.
Tab one: elusive efficiency for total efficiency on specialized skills and quickness boots for base agility.
Tab two: Sanic speed for base agility and garb of unaging quality for agility from equipment.
Telekinetic logs gives catching efficiency per power of 10 logs in storage; a billion logs gives about 23.6% more.
Have as many logs as possible in the storage chest before sampling since more bonuses amplify telekinetic logs.
Briar patch runner makes agility give more catching efficiency; sunset on the vines gives more AFK gains while catching.
Bug enthusiast only gives catching exp so he doesn't normally put points there.
Other useful tab three talents: agility (more levels on quickness boots) swifty statues (boosts old reliable) and shoe full of opals.
Tab four adaptation revelation gives percent agility and max levels for quickness boots.
Skill ambidexter is the most important tab four talent; makes agility affect skill efficiency more and gives base agility.
Symbols of beyond gives extra talent levels to any talent with at least one point; he has 10 free levels per talent.
Family guy gives a larger family bonus than displayed; family bonus gives agility to this character plus minor extras.
Toilet paper postage gives skill efficiency but has diminishing returns.
Past about 1.5 times bonus toilet paper postage scaling is bad and not worth points unless spare points.
Will of the eldest gives base stats based on highest level of each class.
Will of the eldest gives about 45-50 agility for him because his highest character is about level 450.
Tick tock gives more AFK gain rate from skills.
Tab two star talents: frothy brew for potion and boost food bonus super source for base efficiency action frenzy for skilling speed.
Tab three: stat overload gives flat agility that nothing multiplies but is still a bonus.
Shoe fly star sign gives 5% catching efficiency and 20% multi-bug chance.
Mount eus star sign gives 15% to all food effect.
If food effects aren't good use big coma toast star sign for skill AFK gain rate; hydrant tab only choice is 4% skill AFK gain.
Feasty statue gives more food effect and helps non-witches and speed foods.
Old reliable statue gives more catching power.
Worth picking up golden statue unlocks since it's cheap and makes statues account-wide.
On combat tab take stamps giving agility such as agile stamp and sash stamp; stat graph stamp gives base stats.
Catch nut stamp gives base catching efficiency and keeps scaling; continue leveling even when underleveled notification appears.
Buzz stamp gives multi-bug chance.
Multi-tool stamp gives all skill efficiency; very expensive but late game a lot of efficiency.
Sandy pot companion gives more base to all stats; more agility helps catching.
Boar bean companion gives 5% AFK gain rate to fighting and skills.
Multi companion gives 5% to all skill efficiency.
Sheepie ensures big bubbles always equipped; rift slug gives +25 levels to all talents so worth getting.
King doot gives access to all divinities and 3% AFK gain from all characters having goat god equipped.
With king doot all characters have goat god so you can sample with all characters at once without losing gains.
Swift stepping bubble gives total agility per bubble level.
Swift stepping shows 1582 but has several multipliers so it's about five times per point.
Archer or bust multiplies all green bubbles for archer-based classes giving more agility from swift stepping.
Sanic tools gives 45% more skilling power to catching nets and is worth leveling; archer or bust multiplies it.
Bug squared must be equipped; raises max multi-bug chance to 300% and needs level 185 to max without other bonuses.
Additional multi-bug chance comes from stamps and star signs.
Pen prime green multiplies first and seventh bubbles improving catching efficiency and agility.
Slabo critter bug gives catching power based on slab items; about 1400 items gives roughly 28 catching power.
Critter bug isn't a huge gain since nothing multiplies catching power like it does on your tool.
Slabo agility is last green bubble affecting catching; gives agility based on slab roughly 200 agility.
Prowess bubble reduces the catching efficiency needed for next multi-bug multiplier step and caps at two times from all sources.
Prowess bubble post office box and leek in dinner menu all add up to the 2x cap; don't overlevel early game.
A yellow bubble gives talent levels to toilet paper postage stamp talent.
Little benefit leveling it past about 1.5 times but can if you have spare talent points.
Samplit increases total sample size from the 3D printer.
Big P bubble is mandatory giving 30% more minor link bonus on divinity gods; mostly useful for goat god.
Level all vials because every vial gets a bonus from vial mastery in the rift.
Egg gross vial gives catching efficiency; max it out.
Snow slurry increases printer sample size.
Pearl seltzer gives 3.5% all stats at level two; level two is cheap then gets expensive but grab it.
Catching box gives catching efficiency prowess effect and AFK gain for catching; food box gives boost food effect.
Second tab: utility crate for printer sample size sailing crate for agility and myriad crate for base stats and efficiency.
Myriad crate needs 100000 boxes to max so not early game priority.
He uses catching opals in small slots: circles catching power squares 3 catching power hexagons 2% catching efficiency.
Best in slot is the dilapidated slush opal giving 4% all skill efficiency.
For sparkle opal use all AFK gain rate a new world five boss drop.
Without the AFK sparkle opal use catching sparkle for 8% catching efficiency.
He doesn't use catching opals in small slots for lack of room in circles; squares use catching power.
Dilapidated slushes give 4% skill efficiency versus 2% catching efficiency; for sparkles choose AFK gain or catching efficiency.
Opals total gives about 100-120 agility plus catching power efficiency skill efficiency and AFK gain.
Equip royal sampler for more 3D printer sample size.
Don't overlevel royal sampler as it nukes your exp gain.
Equip zerg rush for more AFK gain rate and skilled dewit for skill efficiency.
Avoid balance of proficiency (reduces skill efficiency) and rock sack (reduces AFK gain rate).
Helium bubble talent power stacker adds zeros to resources for telekinetic logs; level six gives six more zeros so much more catching efficiency.
Sapphire nette gives 4% to all stats raising agility and catching efficiency.
Certified stamp book doubles bonuses from all stamps.
My first chemistry set doubles all vial bonuses.
Black diamond rhinestone gives 24% multiplier to all dinner menu meals.
Use card doubler chips for top left and bottom right card slots and the blue chip 15% skill AFK gain rate.
Last four chips are orange chips that double star signs trophy upper keychain slot and pendant.
Put best keychain in top slot; divine scarf 25% AFK gain is doubled by pendant chip.
Corn gives 2% skill efficiency per dinner plate level.
Rice ball gives 3% skill efficiency per dinner plate level.
Leek gives skilling prowess and caps at two times so don't overlevel it too early.
Whipped cocoa gives 4% skill efficiency per dinner plate level a very large bonus; all dinner items multiplied by rhinestone 24%.
Shiny pet passives are small but add up; take a lot of time to level up.
Shiny passives: bonuses from all meals at 1% per level per pet and base skill efficiency for all skills.
Base agility passives are important even if small because base gets multiplied.
Skill mastery gives bonuses by total account skill level: 500 total gives 5% all skill efficiency and 750 gives 1% printer output.
With 15 skills these give about 75% all skill efficiency and about 15% printer output.
Catching skill mastery gives 10% catching efficiency and makes all catching cards passive.
With catching cards passive you can equip cards for all AFK gain rate or all skill efficiency instead.
Vial mastery gives 2% per maxed vial (level 13 crown); 38 maxed vials gives 76% more to all vials.
Ruby cards are a grind allowing one more card tier and upgrading card set for 8% more skill efficiency.
Infinite star signs keeps all star signs active and with card doubler doubles them for catching efficiency and multi-catch chance.
Frost relic gives 30% efficiency for skills in worlds 1-3 tripled to 90% including catching.
Sigils in alchemy double relic bonus; with eldr form it's tripled giving six times the bonus.
Emoji veggie sigil multiplies golden food for more stats.
Pumped kicks sigil gives 20 more agility.
Dream catcher at golden gives 3% all skill AFK gain and 18% with sigil multiplication.
Fury relic gives more max talent book level for library.
Socrates relic gives 30% more all stats meaning 30% more agility.
Gold relic gives 2-3% more printing output per day since last sample; sampling resets this bonus.
Time your sampling at the right moment so you keep getting maximum bonuses; waiting longer gives more printing.
Link the sampling main character to the snake god for 30% AFK gain rate.
Link one to two characters with snake god and the other eight to nine to goat god.
Goat god minor link gives 3.7% AFK gain per linked character; with eight or nine that's 30-33% totaling about 60-63% on the sampling character.
With king doot all characters have goat setup so you can sample with all characters at the same time.
Linking to harp god gives three times more from the 3D printer.
Harp also multiplies with the lab bonus; character in lab linked to harp prints six times resources great for printing logs for atoms.
Go to the bugs or flies sample area with a high-damage character to break open bugs then catch and hit sample.
He has damage talents so he doesn't need to swap characters and gets a multiplier to bugs.
Go through every map and zone breaking bugs and catching samples to finish your daily catching sampling.
